question: Latest completed wheel Flat ROA: joint jitter and matching historical Native comparisons

method.tracking_xy_metric: sqrt(mean(component errors squared over both xy components))
method.hip_target: first two raw actions times .25; hip velocity selected by joint names
method.reset_exclusion: done step and following 49 steps excluded; differences only between consecutive valid samples; displacement and heading null for windows containing done
method.estimated_velocity: student minus same-step pre-action truth; not post-action root velocity
method.per_joint_target_units: first eight rad, last two rad/s; wheel/leg raw magnitudes not directly comparable
method.spectrum: Mean-subtracted rectangular-window RFFT with one-sided Parseval weights; fixed 50 Hz sampling; 5-25 and 10-25 Hz bands; excludes windows with resets; not physics-substep or hardware spectra

analysis_source.python:
from pathlib import Path
import json,gzip,hashlib,sys,datetime
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
sys.path.insert(0,'.agents/skills/monitor-tune-isaaclab-training/scripts')
from summarize_evaluation_batch import validate_batch
root=Path.cwd(); base=root/'learnings/policy_tuning/RobotLab-Isaac-Velocity-Flat-LW-wheel-Roa-v0'
run='2026-09-23_17-23-24'; batch='flat-roa-final-assess-20260924-001'
out=base/run/'evidence/analysis'/batch
def ref(p):
 p=Path(p);return {'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
oldfile=base/'2026-09-21_20-20-10/evidence/analysis/delay30-assess-20260922-001/metrics.json'
old=json.loads(oldfile.read_text())
mfile=base/run/'evaluations'/batch/'manifest.json'
manifest=validate_batch(mfile)
assert len(manifest['cases'])==6 and all(c['status']=='completed' for c in manifest['cases'])
for r in old['batches']: validate_batch(Path(r['path']),expected_sha256=r['sha256'])
joint_order=['right_hip_joint','left_hip_joint','right_thigh_joint','left_thigh_joint','right_shank_joint','left_shank_joint','right_foot_joint','left_foot_joint','right_wheel_joint','left_wheel_joint']
def analyze(result_path):
 result_path=Path(result_path);r=json.loads(result_path.read_text())
 tf=Path(r['telemetry_path']);t=json.loads(gzip.decompress(tf.read_bytes()));s=t['samples'];n=len(s)
 assert n==r['duration_steps'] and [z['step'] for z in s]==list(range(n))
 assert t['telemetry_status']=='complete' and not t['missing_required_signals']
 def arr(key): return np.array([z[key] for z in s],dtype=float)
 a=arr('action');vel=arr('joint_velocity');tor=arr('applied_torque');w=arr('root_angular_velocity_b');v=arr('root_linear_velocity_b');cmd=arr('command');pos=arr('root_position_w');q=arr('root_quaternion_w')
 assert all(np.isfinite(x).all() for x in [a,vel,tor,w,v,cmd,pos,q])
 assert t['step_dt_seconds']==.02 and t['stride']==1
 ids=[t['joint_names'].index(j) for j in joint_order];h=ids[:2];wheel=ids[8:]
 target=a*np.array([.25]*8+[1]*2)
 done=np.array([z['done'] for z in s]); valid=np.ones(n,bool)
 for d in np.where(done)[0]: valid[d:min(n,d+50)]=False
 limits=np.array(t['joint_effort_limits'])
 yaw=np.unwrap(np.arctan2(2*(q[:,0]*q[:,3]+q[:,1]*q[:,2]),1-2*(q[:,2]**2+q[:,3]**2)))
 def spectral_band_rms(values,lo_hz):
  centered=values-values.mean(axis=0,keepdims=True)
  z=np.fft.rfft(centered,axis=0);freq=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(values),d=.02)
  weight=np.full(len(freq),2.);weight[0]=1.
  if len(values)%2==0:weight[-1]=1.
  return np.sqrt(np.sum(abs(z[freq>=lo_hz])**2*weight[freq>=lo_hz,None],axis=0)/len(values)**2)
 stages=old['method']['turn_stages_half_open_steps'] if n==4500 else {'startup_0_1s':[0,50],'standing_1_40s':[50,2000],'standing_40_120s':[2000,6000]}
 result={'result':ref(result_path),'telemetry':ref(tf),'scenario':r['inputs']['scenario']['contract'],'telemetry_status':t['telemetry_status'],'official_metrics':r['metrics'],'done_steps':np.where(done)[0].tolist(),'timeout_steps':[z['step'] for z in s if z['timeout']],'stages':{},'joint_order':joint_order,'roa_diagnostic_signals_available': 'roa_student_velocity_b' in s[0]}
 for name,(lo,hi) in stages.items():
  ix=np.arange(lo,hi)[valid[lo:hi]]; pairs=ix[1:][np.diff(ix)==1]
  rms=lambda x:float(np.sqrt(np.mean(x*x)))
  xx={'valid_samples':len(ix),'excluded_samples':hi-lo-len(ix),
   'body_roll_pitch_angvel_rms_rad_s':float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.sum(w[ix,:2]**2,axis=1)))),
   'body_roll_pitch_angvel_peak_rad_s':float(np.max(np.linalg.norm(w[ix,:2],axis=1))),
   'hip_target_rms_rad':rms(target[ix,:2]),'hip_target_peak_rad':float(np.max(abs(target[ix,:2]))),
   'hip_target_step_rms_rad':rms(target[pairs,:2]-target[pairs-1,:2]),
   'hip_velocity_rms_rad_s':rms(vel[ix][:,h]),'hip_velocity_peak_rad_s':float(np.max(abs(vel[ix][:,h]))),
   'tracking_xy_rmse_m_s':rms(v[ix,:2]-cmd[ix,:2]),
   'tracking_yaw_rmse_rad_s':rms(w[ix,2]-cmd[ix,2]),
   'mean_body_velocity_xyz_m_s':v[ix].mean(axis=0).tolist(),'mean_body_yaw_rate_rad_s':float(w[ix,2].mean()),
   'net_xy_displacement_m':None if done[lo:hi].any() else float(np.linalg.norm(pos[hi-1,:2]-pos[lo,:2])),
   'world_heading_change_rad':None if done[lo:hi].any() else float(yaw[hi-1]-yaw[lo]),
   'hip_torque_max_utilization':float(np.max(abs(tor[ix][:,h])/limits[h])),
   'wheel_torque_max_utilization':float(np.max(abs(tor[ix][:,wheel])/limits[wheel])),
   'per_joint_target_step_rms':[rms(target[pairs,j]-target[pairs-1,j]) for j in range(10)],
   'per_joint_velocity_rms_rad_s':[rms(vel[ix,j]) for j in ids],
   'per_joint_control_sampled_acceleration_rms_rad_s2':[rms((vel[pairs,j]-vel[pairs-1,j])/.02) for j in ids],
   'per_joint_target_second_difference_rms':[rms(target[pairs[1:],j]-2*target[pairs[1:]-1,j]+target[pairs[1:]-2,j]) for j in range(10)] if not done.any() else None}
  if len(ix)==hi-lo:
   for cutoff in [5,10]:
    band=spectral_band_rms(vel[ix][:,ids],cutoff)
    xx[f'per_joint_velocity_band_{cutoff}_25Hz_rms_rad_s']=band.tolist()
    xx[f'hip_velocity_band_{cutoff}_25Hz_rms_rad_s']=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(band[:2]**2)))
    band=spectral_band_rms(target[ix],cutoff)
    xx[f'per_joint_target_band_{cutoff}_25Hz_rms']=band.tolist()
  if result['roa_diagnostic_signals_available']:
   err=arr('roa_student_velocity_b')[ix]-arr('roa_true_velocity_b')[ix]
   xx['estimated_velocity_error_rms_xyz_m_s']=np.sqrt(np.mean(err**2,axis=0)).tolist()
   xx['estimated_velocity_bias_xyz_m_s']=err.mean(axis=0).tolist()
  result['stages'][name]=xx
 if result['roa_diagnostic_signals_available']:
  result['student_action_max_error']=float(np.max(abs(a-arr('roa_student_action'))))
  result['teacher_truth_max_error']=float(np.max(abs(arr('roa_teacher_velocity_b')-arr('roa_true_velocity_b'))))
 return result
cases={k:analyze(c['result']['path']) for k,c in old['cases'].items()}
maxerr=0.
for k,c in old['cases'].items():
 for st,vals in c['stages'].items():
  for key,value in vals.items():
   if key in cases[k]['stages'][st] and value is not None:
    other=cases[k]['stages'][st][key]
    if other is not None:maxerr=max(maxerr,float(np.max(np.abs(np.array(other)-np.array(value)))))
assert maxerr<1e-10,maxerr
for c in manifest['cases']:
 case=analyze(c['result']['path']); key=run+'/'+c['scenario']['scenario_id'];cases[key]=case
comparisons={}
for key,new in cases.items():
 if not key.startswith(run+'/'):continue
 scenario=key.split('/')[-1]
 for oldrun in ['2026-09-16_15-12-04','2026-09-19_11-41-48','2026-09-21_20-20-10']:
  oldkey=oldrun+'/'+scenario
  if oldkey not in cases:continue
  prev=cases[oldkey]; assert new['scenario']==prev['scenario'],(key,oldkey)
  changes={}
  for stage,vals in new['stages'].items():
   changes[stage]={}
   for metric,val in vals.items():
    oldval=prev['stages'][stage].get(metric)
    if isinstance(val,(int,float)) and isinstance(oldval,(int,float)) and oldval!=0:
     changes[stage][metric]=(val/oldval-1)*100
  comparisons[key+' vs '+oldkey]={'scenario_contract_equal':True,'change_percent':changes}
fig,axs=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(14,9))
colors={'2026-09-19_11-41-48':'#8a8a8a','2026-09-21_20-20-10':'#dd8f24',run:'#1479b8'}
labels=['right 15 ms','left 15 ms','right 30 ms','left 30 ms']
scenarios=['right-delay15-noise','left-delay15-noise','right-delay30-noise','left-delay30-noise']
for ax,metric,label in zip(axs.flat,
 ['hip_target_step_rms_rad','hip_velocity_band_5_25Hz_rms_rad_s','body_roll_pitch_angvel_rms_rad_s','tracking_yaw_rmse_rad_s'],
 ['Hip target step RMS (rad)','Hip velocity 5-25 Hz RMS (rad/s)','Body roll/pitch rate RMS (rad/s)','Yaw tracking RMSE (rad/s)']):
 for j,(rid,color) in enumerate(colors.items()):
  vals=[cases[rid+'/'+sc]['stages']['turn_steady_42_70s'][metric] for sc in scenarios]
  ax.bar(np.arange(4)+(j-1)*.24,vals,width=.24,label=rid[:10],color=color)
 ax.set_xticks(range(4),labels);ax.set_ylabel(label);ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.2)
axs[0,0].legend();fig.suptitle('Matching Native scenarios | turn steady 42-70 s | seed 42, one environment\nLower jitter and lower tracking error must be judged together')
fig.tight_layout();plot=out/'comparison.png';fig.savefig(plot,dpi=160);plt.close(fig)
data={'version':1,'created_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'question':'Latest completed wheel Flat ROA: joint jitter and matching historical Native comparisons',
 'batch':ref(mfile),'historical_batches':old['batches'],'historical_analysis':ref(oldfile),
 'method':dict(old['method'],historical_recompute_max_abs_error=maxerr,per_joint_target_units='first eight rad, last two rad/s; wheel/leg raw magnitudes not directly comparable',joint_order=joint_order,spectrum='Mean-subtracted rectangular-window RFFT with one-sided Parseval weights; fixed 50 Hz sampling; 5-25 and 10-25 Hz bands; excludes windows with resets; not physics-substep or hardware spectra'),
 'cases':cases,'comparisons':comparisons,'plot':ref(plot),
 'static_replay':ref(base/run/'evidence/analysis/static-realdata-final-20260924-001/metrics.json'),
 'training_review':ref(base/run/'evidence/training/tensorboard-review-20260924-001.json'),
 'analysis_source':{'python':analysis_source,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(analysis_source.encode()).hexdigest()},
 'limitations':['One seed and one environment; no hardware reproduction.','Static replay has frozen historical observations and no action feedback; it is not a stability proof.','No approved convergence acceptance criteria; convergence indeterminate.','No parameter causal attribution: several rewards and delay differ across training runs.','30 ms fixed delay is outside latest 0-15 ms training range.'],
 'assessment':{'status':'insufficient_evidence','convergence':'indeterminate','reason':'No approved acceptance thresholds; this batch characterizes behavior only'},'direct_parameter_change_supported':False}
dest=out/'metrics.json';assert not dest.exists();dest.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
ver={'metrics':ref(dest),'historical_recompute_max_abs_error':maxerr,'batches_validated':5,'native_cases_completed':6,'total_new_steps':sum(c['scenario']['duration_steps'] for c in manifest['cases']),'plot_visual_reviewed':False}
(out/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(ver,indent=2)+'\n')
for key,c in cases.items():
 if not key.startswith(run+'/'):continue
 st='turn_steady_42_70s' if 'delay' in key else 'standing_40_120s'
 print(key, 'done',c['done_steps'],json.dumps(c['stages'][st]))
print('SAVED',dest,'RECOMPUTE_ERROR',maxerr)
